_comment: Template: Check SHACL shape files against the SHACL-SHACL shapes.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar shacl-check --config this-file.json
_note_shaclFiles: Shape files (.ttl, .rdf). Exit 0 when all conform, 1 when one does not, 2 when one can't be read.
